# NOVA

> Real-time translated captions for live calls, with participant access designed for viewing rather than speaking.

NOVA lets authorized hosts create live calls and share a link or QR code. Participants can join from a browser and read translated captions in their selected language.

## Public pages

- [Join a live call](/watch): Open the participant entry page for a shared live-call invitation.
- [Host sign in](/login): Sign in as an authorized host to create and manage a live call.
